description: Patient age in years at baseline
Biological sex of the patient (Female, Male)
Clinical intent of treatment (Curative vs Palliative)
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (0 to 3)
History of cancer surgery prior to chemo (1=Yes, 0=No)
History of radiation therapy prior to chemo (1=Yes, 0=No)
Time elapsed since initial cancer diagnosis in months
Total count of chronic comorbid medical conditions
Diagnosis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (1=Yes, 0=No)
Clinical diagnosis or history of depression (1=Yes, 0=No)
Active prescription for non-opioid pain medication (1=Yes, 0=No)
Total number of concurrent active prescription drug classes
Emergency department visits in the past 6 months
Inpatient hospital admissions in the past 6 months
Outpatient psychiatry appointments in the past 6 months
Resting heart rate in beats per minute
Respiratory rate in breaths per minute
Percentage of body weight lost over the past 6 months
Alanine aminotransferase liver enzyme in U/L
C-reactive protein inflammatory marker in mg/L
Lactate dehydrogenase tissue injury marker in U/L
Prostate-specific antigen tumor marker in ng/mL
PROMIS Global Physical Health standardized T-score before chemo
PROMIS Global Mental Health standardized T-score before chemo
PROMIS Global Physical Health T-score during chemo (label leakage)
Primary target: 1 if GPH dropped by 10+ points during chemo, 0 otherwise
Secondary outcome: 1 if on-chemo GPH is 40 or below, 0 otherwise
